report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-350ms durations; traces show healthy order, inventory, payment, postgres and redis spans with pool size 1 and idle 1. Metrics show zero 502s and no dependency errors. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert's latency spike is not corroborated. Handing off rather than asserting a cause.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error telemetry on /v1/checkout beyond the single 344ms sample
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, payment, inventory, postgres, redis
Connection pool saturation or wait-time metrics for postgres
Redis operation timeout or error logs
Deployment/version change records correlated with the alert window
